name: Deskera
description_en:
Deskera presents cloud ERP and MRP products covering financials, inventory, order fulfillment and manufacturing. The official root redirected to its Singapore-facing site during this research, so the prices and descriptions below are scoped to the pages actually obtained.

ERP order handling and MRP production planning are related but separately presented offers. A company should identify which it needs, the retained plan and implementation scope. This profile did not create an account, import records or execute a manufacturing/order flow.
description_zh:
Deskera 提供云 ERP 和 MRP 产品，覆盖财务、库存、订单履约及制造。本次访问官方根地址跳转至新加坡站，因此下文价格与描述仅对应实际读取页面。

ERP 订单处理和 MRP 生产规划相关，但以不同方案展示。企业需确定所需产品、最终保留套餐和实施范围。本文未创建账户、导入记录或执行制造订单流程。

core_features.explanation_en: The order product describes sales orders, reserved stock, pick-pack-ship, dropshipping and returns.
core_features.explanation_zh: 订单产品介绍销售订单、库存预留、拣包装运、直发及退货。

core_features.explanation_en: MRP describes multilevel BOMs, work orders, material planning, production and WIP tracking.
core_features.explanation_zh: MRP 介绍多层物料清单、工单、物料规划、生产及在制品跟踪。

core_features.name_zh: 按套餐提供的财务运营
core_features.explanation_en: The pricing cards distinguish accounting/inventory from added financial controls, report builder and enterprise capabilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 定价卡片区分会计库存基础范围，以及附加财务控制、报表构建和企业能力。

pricing.billing_basis: Selected ERP/MRP plan, annual billing, minimum five users; required implementation/setup excluded; ISO currency not established.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: ERP Growth from $199/user/month, annual minimum 5 users; MRP Growth separately from $349/user/month on the same displayed minimum. Setup extra.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: ERP Growth 每用户每月起价 $199，年付至少五用户；MRP Growth 另列起价 $349，同样最低条件；设置费另计。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Connect a customer order to stock and shipment
sections.title_zh: 连接客户订单、库存与发运
sections.en:
The order page describes orders from online stores and marketplaces, stock reservation, dropship fulfillment, picking lists, shipping documents, backorders, returns and refunds. A shared order view does not by itself prove every marketplace connector or carrier is configured.

For a hypothetical order with a stocked line and a backordered line, inspect reservation, partial shipment, the remaining demand and the customer invoice. Then test a return against the shipped line. These are proposed checks of the described scope, not executed transactions. The exact behavior on duplicate imports, late warehouse updates or failed shipment requests was not established by the public page.
sections.zh:
订单页介绍来自网店和市场平台的订单、库存预留、供应商直发、拣货单、发运单据、欠货、退货及退款。共用订单视图并不能证明所有市场连接器或承运商已经配置。

可用一条有库存、一条欠货的假设订单，检查预留、部分发运、剩余需求和客户发票，再对已发运行测试退货。这些是针对所述范围的建议检查，并未执行交易；重复导入、仓库更新滞后或发运请求失败的具体行为未从公开页确立。

sections.title_en: MRP adds production work, not merely an inventory label
sections.title_zh: MRP 增加生产任务，而非一个库存标签
sections.en:
The MRP page describes multilevel BOMs, work orders, material requirements, WIP, by-products/scrap and finished-good costing. It also presents production scheduling, quality checks and contract manufacturing under the higher plan. Ad hoc BOMs are described for one-time or custom runs.

Evaluate one finished item with components and a routing, then record actual material, labor and scrap. Compare available components, planned production and the resulting cost. This is a suggested acceptance example. Do not treat a feature heading as evidence of regulated process validation, machine connectivity or a specific factory’s finite-capacity model. Confirm which capabilities belong to the quoted MRP plan.
sections.zh:
MRP 页面介绍多层物料清单、工单、物料需求、在制品、副产品报废及成品成本；较高套餐还展示生产排程、质量检查和合同制造，临时 BOM 用于一次性或定制生产。

可用带组件和路线的一个成品评估，记录实际物料、人工和报废，再比较可用组件、生产计划及形成的成本。这是建议验收。功能标题不能证明受监管流程验证、机器连接或特定工厂的有限产能模型，需确认报价 MRP 套餐具体包含哪些能力。

sections.title_en: A per-user starting price has a five-user annual minimum
sections.title_zh: 每用户起价附带五用户年付最低要求
sections.en:
The ERP pricing page read on 22 October 2026 lists Growth starting at $199 per user monthly, billed annually for at least five users, and Mid Market at $249 on that basis. The MRP page separately lists Growth at $349 and Mid Market at $449 per user monthly with the same displayed annual/five-user condition. Enterprise is a sales discussion. An ISO currency code was not established from the dollar sign alone.

For a hypothetical five-user ERP Growth commitment, $199 × 5 equals $995 per month equivalent, or $11,940 for twelve months before taxes and required setup/implementation. MRP Growth’s equivalent would be $1,745 monthly or $20,940 yearly on those assumptions. These calculations compare displayed bases; they do not establish that ERP and MRP must be added together or that a combined package has that price.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的 ERP 定价页列出 Growth 起价每用户每月 $199，按年付款且至少五用户；Mid Market 同基础为 $249。MRP 页面另列 Growth $349、Mid Market $449，同样展示年付及五用户条件，Enterprise 需销售沟通。本次不凭 $ 符号确立 ISO 币种。

假设五用户 ERP Growth，$199 × 5 折合每月 $995，十二个月为 $11,940，尚未计税及必需的设置实施费；按同样假设，MRP Growth 折合每月 $1,745、每年 $20,940。这些只是展示计费基础的算例，不能证明 ERP 与 MRP 必须相加，也不能作为组合套餐价格。

sections.title_en: Plan and product boundaries matter after trial
sections.title_zh: 试用后产品及套餐边界仍重要
sections.en:
ERP Growth lists accounting, financial reports, bank connections, CRM and warehouse/lot/serial tracking. Mid Market adds financial controls, warehouse roles, time tracking, landed costs and report building. Enterprise lists revenue recognition, multibook accounting and custom capabilities. Both ERP and MRP pages exclude required one-time implementation/setup fees from displayed cost.

The pricing FAQ describes fifteen days of access to the selected product and plan, including invited users during that trial. This is not evidence of an ongoing free ERP or an unrestricted trial of every product. The free mobile-app statement does not erase the business subscription. Retain the plan matrix and written scope when checking what remains available after evaluation.
sections.zh:
ERP Growth 列出会计、财务报表、银行连接、CRM 及仓库批次序列号；Mid Market 增加财务控制、仓库角色、工时、到岸成本和报表构建；Enterprise 列出收入确认、多账簿和定制能力。ERP 及 MRP 页面都明确展示金额不含必需的一次性实施设置费。

定价 FAQ 介绍所选产品和套餐的十五天访问，期间可邀请用户；不能据此认定存在永久免费 ERP 或不受限制的全产品试用。“免费移动应用”也不会免去业务订阅，评估后应按套餐表和书面范围核对保留权限。

sections.title_en: Prepare financial and production masters before migration
sections.title_zh: 迁移前准备财务和生产基础资料
sections.en:
Prepare entity/currency settings, chart and opening balances, item units, warehouses, customer/vendor records, BOMs/routes and approval responsibilities. For manufacturing, agree how scrap, by-products, yields and outsourced work enter costs before importing stock or open work orders.

The suite is worth investigating for a business connecting financial and stock/production operations. A smaller invoice-only need should first assess the five-user annual commitment and required implementation. Ask for duplicate-order and failed-production examples, data export and recovery evidence. UI languages, bank/connector eligibility, contractual service guarantees, self-hosting/license rights and actual performance were not verified. Marketing ratings and promised implementation speed were not adopted as independent results.
sections.zh:
应准备实体币种、科目期初余额、物品单位、仓库、客户供应商、物料路线及审批责任。制造场景还要在导入库存或未结工单前，商定报废、副产品、产出率及外包工作如何进入成本。

需要连接财务与库存生产运营的企业可以评估；只有简单开票需求时，应先衡量五用户年付承诺和必需实施。应取得重复订单和生产失败示例、导出及恢复证据。本文未核实界面语言、银行连接资格、合同服务保证、自托管许可或真实性能，也未把营销评分和实施速度当成独立结果。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Exact currency, combined ERP/MRP package scope, implementation quote, regional bank/payment eligibility and contract guarantees remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 确切币种、ERP/MRP 组合范围、实施报价、地区银行支付资格及合同保证未核实。

research_gaps.en: No order, manufacturing build, tax filing, connector, migration, mobile parity, export or restore was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试订单、生产、税务申报、连接器、迁移、移动端一致性、导出或恢复。
